summary_1line: Ghatotkacha slays the Rakshasa Alamvusha and then wages a terrifying illusion-filled night battle against Karna that throws the Kaurava army into chaos.

image_candidates.scene_text: Ghatotkacha seizes Alamvusha, hacks off his roaring head with a scimitar, and hurls the blood-soaked head onto Duryodhana's chariot.
The gigantic Ghatotkacha towers on his many-wheeled chariot beneath a banner with a blood-red vulture as Karna stands firm amid fleeing armies at night.
In the dark sky Ghatotkacha becomes a vast mountain raining spears and rocks while Karna calmly shatters the illusion with a celestial weapon.
